description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Sofa in central living area facing the TV on the interior wall; an additional armchair/seating near the kitchen-dining zone. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall right of entry. Cook can see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: direct into living, first thing visible on arrival is living area. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via through living, no walk-in wardrobe. Master bedroom is only accessible through the living room — no direct corridor access, least private position. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: large families needing multiple bedrooms; households requiring a home office or dedicated workspace; people needing accessible step-free wide circulation due to narrow elongated layout.
